---
title: "Pequod for Quarto"
subtitle: "Warm paper, deep ink, eight crew accents — across reveal, html, and typst"
---

A Quarto extension that applies the [Pequod palette](https://github.com/tiagojct/pequod)
to slide decks, documents, and PDFs. Body and headings render in
Atkinson Hyperlegible Next; code renders in Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono.
Both fonts are bundled inside the theme — no Google Fonts CDN at render
time, GDPR-clean, offline-renderable, cached once per site.

## The four formats

| Format | Use for | Surface |
|---|---|---|
| `pequod-revealjs` | Slide decks | Warm paper |
| `pequod-dark-revealjs` | Slide decks | Deep ink |
| `pequod-html` | Documents, reports, articles | Warm paper, dark variant via toggle |
| `pequod-typst` | PDF output | Warm paper |

Syntax highlighting in a slide matches syntax highlighting in a report
matches syntax highlighting in a PDF, because all four formats share the
same crew → role mapping:

| Role | Crew | Light hex | Dark hex |
|---|---|---|---|
| Keyword | Ahab | `#A83732` | `#E3877C` |
| Function | Starbuck | `#0082B1` | `#A6DFFF` |
| Type | Queequeg | `#253E82` | `#838CCF` |
| Number | Pip | `#6A4A00` | `#DEC577` |
| Comment | Ishmael | `#76716B` | `#BFBBB6` |
| Constant | Stubb | `#CA6435` | `#FFD9BB` |
| String | Tashtego | `#177C55` | `#82C4A2` |
| Variable | Daggoo | `#552823` | `#A17069` |

## Quick look

::: {.callout-note}
This very documentation site is rendered with `pequod-html`. The
theme-toggle in the navbar flips between the warm-paper and deep-ink
variants — the toggle ships with the extension and works out of the
box once `theme-toggle: true` is set in your project's `_quarto.yml`.
:::

```python
# Inline code, code blocks, and tables all read the same register.
import numpy as np

def loss(theta: np.ndarray, x: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray) -> float:
    """Mean squared error for a linear model."""
    return float(np.mean((x @ theta - y) ** 2))
```

> A whale-ship was my Yale College and my Harvard.

See [Install](install.qmd) to pull the extension into your project, or
[Formats](formats.qmd) for the per-format YAML knobs.
